{"step":3,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_consume","line":86,"var":"mmr->data[mmr->data_index + 4]","code":"if (mmr->data_index + 4 < mmr->size) mmr->word |= (mmr->data[mmr->data_index + 4] << mmr->bit_index);","note":"The decoder prebuffers upcoming bytes and skips the actual read when the lookahead runs beyond the available input."},
{"step":4,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_consume","line":88,"var":"mmr->data_index","code":"mmr->data_index++;","note":"Even when no new byte is fetched, the internal consumed-byte cursor still advances."},

]
